repos_data.description: Go client for the GeoServer REST API — workspaces, datastores, layers, styles, security, ACL, GeoWebCache, Importer, plus OWS GetCapabilities/Describe. Tested against GeoServer 2.27 LTS and 2.28 stable.
Self-hosted 4D spatiotemporal AI platform built on PostgreSQL, PostGIS, TimescaleDB, H3 and pgvector, with anomaly & threat detection, NLQ interface and full observability.

Go tool + library that publishes GIS vector data to GeoServer via PostGIS — walks a directory of shapefile / GeoJSON / GeoPackage / KML, loads each into PostGIS via GDAL/OGR, then registers the resulting tables as GeoServer feature types. Idempotent. Tested on GeoServer 2.27 LTS + 2.28 stable.

😎Awesome GIS is a collection of geospatial related sources, including cartographic tools, geoanalysis tools, developer tools, data, conference & communities, news, massive open online course, some amazing map sites, and more.
A STAC/OGC API Features Web Service
NextGIS Web is an open-source Web GIS server for geospatial data management, web map publishing, and QGIS-centered collaborative workflows.
A library provides spatial data and geometric algorithms
A Scala library with primitives to build applications using the SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs specification
Location intelligence for AI agents: place search, geocoding, directions, isochrones & commercial-area analysis across 10 map providers. MCP + REST + CLI + SDK. No API key to start.

repo_meta_data.description: Self-hosted geospatial data catalog with semantic search (pgvector), OGC/STAC APIs, and map builder. Built on FastAPI, PostGIS, React, and MapLibre.
